tables.name: Fortress Type
tables.description: What to build: the General section only, a Keep, a Castle (a keep within curtain walls) or a Stronghold (an upgraded castle). Each builds on the one before.

results.name: General Only
results.description: Only the General section: overall ideas for a fortress.

results.name: Keep
results.description: A single, fortified structure, like a tower or other large, heavy-duty building.

results.name: Castle
results.description: A central keep, surrounded by a curtain wall; the yard inside (the bailey) holds smaller buildings.

results.name: Stronghold
results.description: A super castle: a castle with expanded defenses, bigger and harder to conquer.
